text:
[IRET.11.3.1] Refraction is applied at selection, to the
activation selected ([LDET.5.3]). A fired activation is not
selected again: it left the agenda when it fired and stays on
its terminal's list with the flag set. An activation selected
whose token identity has an entry in the current generation's
table is discarded unfired. When an activation fires, its token
identity (hash + fact-id tuple) is entered in the table at the
current generation.

idris.name: idat_6_2_2__mark_fired
idris.note: Firing marks the token's identity refracted; a flag on the token stands for the set entry, per [IRET.11].

idris.name: iret_11_3_1__pending_count
idris.note: How many of a table are eligible.

idris.name: iret_11_3_1__pending_tok
idris.note: Eligible = not fired and not blocked: refracted activations exist in the table and are skipped at selection, as the clause says.

idris.name: idat_6_2_2__mark_net
idris.note: Firing marks the activation's identity as refracted: its flag.

idris.name: iret_11_3_1__first_unfired
idris.note: Selection skips fired activations: the first not yet fired, in timetag order. In the tick-free fragment the `fired` flag is the whole of refraction.

idris.name: idat_6_2_2__mark_net_view
idris.note: Marking an activation fired keeps the view: it reads the tuples.

idris.name: iret_11_3_1__first_unfired_just
idris.note: The first unfired activation is there, and unfired.

idris.name: iret_11_3_1__first_unfired_nothing
idris.note: A terminal with no first unfired activation has none unfired.

idris.name: iret_11_3_1__hit
idris.note: A set entry that tests equal to an identity is that identity.

idris.name: iret_11_3_1__refracted
idris.note: Whether an identity is in the set: the test the clause's filter applies.

idris.name: iret_11_3_1__refracted_false
idris.note: An identity not in the set is not refracted.

idris.name: iret_11_3__select_spec_agrees
idris.note: Under a sound ghost the clause's filtered selection is the model's.

idris.name: iret_11_4__first_eligible
idris.note: Selection as the clause states it, over the model's terminal: the first activation neither popped -- `fired` is the pop -- nor in the set.

idris.name: iret_11_4__first_eligible_unfired
idris.note: Over a terminal where every refracted identity is fired, the clause's filter skips nothing the flag does not: its choice is the first unfired activation.

idris.name: iret_11_4__mark_g
idris.note: Firing adds the token identity to the terminal's set, beside the flag the model sets.

idris.name: iret_11_4__mark_sound
idris.note: MARKING keeps the ghost sound: the identity entering the set is the marked activation's, which carries `fired` and, identities being distinct, is the only activation with it; the identities already in the set keep their activations, marked or not.

idris.name: iret_11_3_1__any_unblocked
idris.note: A test over the unblocked activations is the test over the tokens, unblocked and read as activations.

idris.name: iret_11_3_1__first_unfired_no
idris.note: A fired head is skipped: the first unfired activation is one position later.

idris.name: iret_11_3_1__first_unfired_yes
idris.note: An unfired head is the first unfired activation.

idris.name: iret_11_3_1__not_pending_free
idris.note: A token that is not pending and not blocked has fired.

idris.name: iret_11_3_1__pending_blocked
idris.note: A blocked token is not pending.

idris.name: iret_11_3_1__pending_fired
idris.note: A fired token is not pending: refracted, so skipped at selection.

idris.name: iret_11_3_1__pending_of
idris.note: An unblocked, unfired token is pending.

idris.name: iret_11_3_1__pending_true
idris.note: A pending token is unblocked and unfired.

idris.name: iret_11_3_1__unblocked_cons_blocked
idris.note: A blocked head leaves the unblocked activations.

idris.name: iret_11_3_1__unblocked_cons_free
idris.note: An unblocked head is the first unblocked activation.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__first_agree
idris.note: THE FIRST PENDING TOKEN of a table is the first unfired activation among its unblocked tokens: both skip the blocked and the fired, so the selected positions name one match.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__mark_agree
idris.note: MARKING THE SELECTED TOKEN marks the selected activation: the unblocked tokens after the mark are the terminal after its mark.

idris.name: iret_11_3_1__unblocked_acts
idris.note: The unblocked tokens of a table, as activations, in table order: what selection sees.

idris.name: iret_11_3_1__unblocked_fwd
idris.note: An unblocked token of the table is among the unblocked activations.

idris.name: iret_11_3_1__unblocked_inv
idris.note: An unblocked activation comes from an unblocked token of the table.

idris.name: iret_11_3_1__unblocked_tuples
idris.note: Tokens as activations carry their tuples.
